# DOT HAZMAT Ground Shipper Certification Training

> 8-hour online training for hazmat employees who prepare or offer hazardous materials for ground transportation, based on the DOT Hazardous Materials Regulations, 49 CFR Parts 171-180, including training requirements in 49 CFR Part 172 Subpart H. Available in English and Spanish. Offered by HAZWOPER OSHA Training (https://hazwoper-osha.com).

## Key facts
- Duration: 8 hours; 9 modules, 19 lessons, final exam
- Credits: 0.8 CEU
- Price: $229.99 per person; bulk pricing available
- Delivery: 100% online, 24/7; SCORM, virtual instructor-led and in-person formats also available
- Languages: English, Spanish
- Prerequisites: none
- Certificate: downloadable on passing; valid 3 years (DOT recurrent training at least every three years)
- Important: does not by itself replace the employer's duty to provide function-specific training matched to each employee's hazmat duties; employees must be trained and tested by their hazmat employer

## Modules
1. Hazardous Materials Regulations (regulatory overview, hazard classes and divisions)
2. Hazardous Materials Table (Columns 1-10, Appendices A and B)
3. Shipping Papers (preparation, additional descriptions, shipper's certification)
4. Packaging
5. Marking
6. Labeling
7. Placarding
8. Carrier Requirements: Highway (DOT and FMCSR, carrier training, loading and unloading, segregation, emergencies)
9. Security Awareness (security and safety plans, specific security measures)

## Who should take it
Shipping and receiving personnel; hazmat shippers and packaging personnel; warehouse and distribution employees; logistics and transportation personnel; shipping coordinators and supervisors; compliance and safety personnel.
